imo-1971-q1.summary: For $n>2$ and arbitrary real numbers $a_1,\ldots,a_n$, put $S_n=\sum_{i=1}^n\prod_{j\ne i}(a_i-a_j)$. Prove that the assertion $S_n\ge0$ for every real choice of the $a_i$ is true exactly for $n=3$ and $n=5$.
imo-1971-q1.summaryZh: 对 $n>2$ 及任意实数 $a_1,\ldots,a_n$，令 $S_n=\sum_{i=1}^n\prod_{j\ne i}(a_i-a_j)$。证明：对所有实数取值恒有 $S_n\ge0$ 当且仅当 $n=3$ 或 $n=5$。
imo-1971-q1.answer: The assertion holds exactly for $n=3$ and $n=5$.
imo-1971-q1.answerZh: 该断言恰在 $n=3$ 与 $n=5$ 时成立。

methods.title: Order the variables and construct counterexamples
steps: For $n=3$, direct expansion gives $S_3=\frac12[(a_1-a_2)^2+(a_1-a_3)^2+(a_2-a_3)^2]\ge0$.

For $n=5$, symmetry lets us assume $a_1\le a_2\le a_3\le a_4\le a_5$ and write $P_i=\prod_{j\ne i}(a_i-a_j)$. Factoring the first pair gives $P_1+P_2=(a_2-a_1)[(a_3-a_1)(a_4-a_1)(a_5-a_1)-(a_3-a_2)(a_4-a_2)(a_5-a_2)]\ge0$.
The same comparison from the other end gives $P_4+P_5\ge0$, while $P_3=(a_3-a_1)(a_3-a_2)(a_4-a_3)(a_5-a_3)\ge0$. Hence $S_5\ge0$, including repeated-value cases.
If $n>2$ is even, take $a_1=-1$ and $a_2=\cdots=a_n=0$. All terms except the first vanish and $S_n=(-1)^{n-1}=-1$.

If $n\ge7$ is odd, take $a_1=a_2=a_3=-1$, $a_4=0$, and $a_5=\cdots=a_n=1$. Terms belonging to repeated values vanish; only the $a_4$ term remains, equal to $1^3(-1)^{n-4}=-1$. Thus every remaining $n$ has a counterexample.
stepsZh: 从另一端同样比较得到 $P_4+P_5\ge0$；中间项 $P_3=(a_3-a_1)(a_3-a_2)(a_4-a_3)(a_5-a_3)\ge0$。故 $S_5\ge0$，即使某些 $a_i$ 相等也成立。
若 $n>2$ 为偶数，取 $a_1=-1$、$a_2=\cdots=a_n=0$。除第一项外其余项都含零因子，于是 $S_n=(-1)^{n-1}=-1$。
若 $n\ge7$ 为奇数，取 $a_1=a_2=a_3=-1$、$a_4=0$、$a_5=\cdots=a_n=1$。重复值对应的项均为零，只剩 $a_4$ 对应项，其值为 $1^3(-1)^{n-4}=-1$。因此其余所有 $n$ 均有反例。

imo-1971-q2.summary: A convex three-dimensional polyhedron $P_1$ has nine vertices $A_1,\ldots,A_9$. For $i=2,\ldots,9$, let $P_i$ be the translate of $P_1$ that sends $A_1$ to $A_i$. Prove that two of $P_1,\ldots,P_9$ have a common interior point.
imo-1971-q2.summaryZh: 一个三维凸多面体 $P_1$ 有九个顶点 $A_1,\ldots,A_9$。对 $i=2,\ldots,9$，令 $P_i$ 为把 $A_1$ 平移到 $A_i$ 后所得的 $P_1$ 的平移像。证明 $P_1,\ldots,P_9$ 中至少两个有公共内点。
imo-1971-q2.answer: At least two of the nine translates overlap in their interiors.
imo-1971-q2.answerZh: 九个平移多面体中至少两个的内部相交。

methods.title: Pack nine equal volumes into a dilation of factor two
methods.titleZh: 把九份等体积多面体装入二倍放大体
steps: Take $A_1$ as the origin, write $P=P_1$, and let $a_i$ be the position vector of $A_i$. Then $P_i=P+a_i$ for $i=1,\ldots,9$.
Every translate lies in the dilation $2P=\{2x:x\in P\}$. Indeed, if $z=x+a_i$ with $x,a_i\in P$, convexity gives $z/2=(x+a_i)/2\in P$.
Let $V>0$ be the volume of $P$. Each $P_i$ has volume $V$, whereas $2P$ has volume $2^3V=8V$.

If the interiors of all nine translates were pairwise disjoint, their boundaries would contribute zero volume and their union would have volume $9V$. But the union is contained in $2P$, whose volume is only $8V$. This contradiction proves that two interiors meet.
stepsZh: 以 $A_1$ 为原点，记 $P=P_1$，并用 $a_i$ 表示顶点 $A_i$ 的位置向量，则 $P_i=P+a_i$，$i=1,\ldots,9$。
每个平移像都包含在二倍放大体 $2P=\{2x:x\in P\}$ 中。事实上，若 $z=x+a_i$，其中 $x,a_i\in P$，则由凸性有 $z/2=(x+a_i)/2\in P$。
设 $P$ 的体积为 $V>0$。每个 $P_i$ 的体积均为 $V$，而 $2P$ 的体积为 $2^3V=8V$。
若九个平移像的内部两两不交，则其边界体积为零，故并集体积为 $9V$。但该并集包含在体积仅为 $8V$ 的 $2P$ 中，矛盾。因此至少两个多面体的内部相交。

imo-1971-q3.summary: Prove that among the integers $2^k-3$ for $k=2,3,\ldots$ there is an infinite subset whose members are pairwise relatively prime.
imo-1971-q3.summaryZh: 证明：在整数集合 $\{2^k-3:k=2,3,\ldots\}$ 中存在一个无限子集，使其中任意两个数都互素。
imo-1971-q3.answer: Such an infinite pairwise-coprime subset can be constructed inductively.
imo-1971-q3.answerZh: 可用归纳构造得到这样的无限两两互素子集。

methods.title: Choose each new exponent modulo the previous product
methods.titleZh: 按已有乘积的模选择新指数
steps: Start with $k_1=3$, so $2^{k_1}-3=5$. Suppose $k_1<\cdots<k_r$ have been chosen and the corresponding numbers are pairwise coprime. Put $M=\prod_{i=1}^r(2^{k_i}-3)$; this $M$ is odd.
Among $2^0,2^1,\ldots,2^M$, two have the same residue modulo $M$. Cancelling the smaller power of $2$, which is invertible modulo odd $M$, gives an integer $d\ge1$ with $2^d\equiv1\pmod M$.
Set $k_{r+1}=2+k_rd$. It is larger than $k_r$, and $2^{k_{r+1}}-3=4(2^d)^{k_r}-3\equiv1\pmod M$.
Therefore the new number is relatively prime to $M$ and hence to every earlier chosen number. The construction continues indefinitely and the increasing exponents give distinct members.
stepsZh: 先取 $k_1=3$，于是 $2^{k_1}-3=5$。假设已选出 $k_1<\cdots<k_r$，且对应各数两两互素。令 $M=\prod_{i=1}^r(2^{k_i}-3)$，则 $M$ 为奇数。
在 $2^0,2^1,\ldots,2^M$ 这 $M+1$ 个数中，至少两个模 $M$ 同余。由于 $M$ 为奇数，可约去较小的 $2$ 的幂，从而得到某个整数 $d\ge1$ 满足 $2^d\equiv1\pmod M$。
所以新得到的数与 $M$ 互素，进而与此前每个数都互素。该构造可无限继续，且严格递增的指数保证所得各数互不相同。

imo-1971-q4.summary: Every face of tetrahedron $ABCD$ is acute. Let $X,Y,Z,T$ range over the interiors of edges $AB,BC,CD,DA$, respectively, and consider the closed path $XYZTX$. Put $a=\angle DAB$, $b=\angle ABC$, $c=\angle BCD$, $d=\angle CDA$, and $\alpha=\angle BAC+\angle CAD+\angle DAB$. (a) Prove that if $a+c\ne b+d$, no such path has minimum length. (b) If $a+c=b+d$, prove that infinitely many shortest paths exist and that their common length is $2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$.
imo-1971-q4.summaryZh: 四面体 $ABCD$ 的每个面都是锐角三角形。令 $X,Y,Z,T$ 分别在棱 $AB,BC,CD,DA$ 的内部，并考虑闭折线 $XYZTX$。记 $a=\angle DAB$、$b=\angle ABC$、$c=\angle BCD$、$d=\angle CDA$，以及 $\alpha=\angle BAC+\angle CAD+\angle DAB$。（a）证明若 $a+c\ne b+d$，则不存在长度最小的这类折线。（b）若 $a+c=b+d$，证明有无穷多条最短折线，且公共长度为 $2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$。
imo-1971-q4.answer: A minimum exists exactly in the balanced case $a+c=b+d$; then infinitely many paths attain $2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$.
imo-1971-q4.answerZh: 仅在平衡条件 $a+c=b+d$ 下存在最短值；此时无穷多条折线达到 $2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$。

methods.title: First variation and unfolding the four faces
methods.titleZh: 一阶变分与四个面的展开
steps: For part (a), suppose a shortest admissible path exists. Moving $X$ slightly along $AB$ while fixing the other points makes the derivative of $XY+XT$ vanish, so $\angle BXY=\angle AXT$. The same first-variation argument at $Y,Z,T$ gives angles $u,v,w,s$ with $\angle BXY=\angle AXT=u$, $\angle BYX=\angle CYZ=v$, $\angle CZY=\angle DZT=w$, and $\angle DTZ=\angle ATX=s$.

The angle sums in triangles $BXY,CYZ,DZT,ATX$ are $u+v+b=\pi$, $v+w+c=\pi$, $w+s+d=\pi$, and $s+u+a=\pi$. Comparing the first plus third with the second plus fourth forces $b+d=a+c$. Thus if the two sums differ, a minimum cannot exist.

Assume now $a+c=b+d$. Unfold the faces in order as $ABC$, $BCD$, $CDA'$, $DA'B'$, placing consecutive faces on opposite sides of their common edge; append a translated-or-reflected copy $A'B'C'$ of $ABC$. The signed turns from $AB$ to $A'B'$ sum to $b-c+d-a=0$, so $\overrightarrow{A'B'}=\overrightarrow{AB}$. Hence the last copy of $ABC$ is a translate of the first by a vector $v$: $A'=A+v$, $B'=B+v$, $C'=C+v$.
Let $\omega=\angle ACB+\angle BCD+\angle DCA$. Triangle angle sums and $a+c=b+d$ give $\alpha+\omega=2\pi$. Since $CA=CA'=AC$, the chord formula yields $|v|=AA'=2AC\sin(\omega/2)=2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$.
Any admissible path unfolds to a polygonal line $XYZTX'$, where $X'$ is the copy of $X$ on $A'B'$, hence $X'=X+v$. The triangle inequality therefore gives $XY+YZ+ZT+TX\ge XX'=|v|$.

It remains to attain the bound. Use the following planar observation: if rays $OP,OQ,OR,OS$ occur successively with three acute intervening angles and $OP=OS$, then, after making chord $PS$ horizontal, $Q$ and $R$ lie strictly above $O$. Their direction angles are $(\pi-p+q+r)/2$ and $(\pi-p-q+r)/2$, both in $(0,\pi)$.

Apply this observation at $C$ to $CA,CB,CD,CA'$ and at $A'$ to $A'C,A'D,A'B',A'C'$. With $v$ horizontal, every point of $\{A,C,A'\}$ lies strictly below every point of $\{B,D,B'\}$. Thus each horizontal line in a nonempty open strip crosses $AB,BC,CD,DA',A'B'$ in interior points $X,Y,Z,T,X'$ and these pieces form the straight segment $XX'$.
Folding back gives a closed path of length $|v|=2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$. The strip contains infinitely many horizontal lines, so it produces infinitely many distinct shortest paths.
stepsZh: 先证（a）。反设存在最短折线。固定其余三点，让 $X$ 沿 $AB$ 作微小移动，则 $XY+XT$ 的导数必须为零，故 $\angle BXY=\angle AXT$。在 $Y,Z,T$ 处同理，记所得角为 $u,v,w,s$，有 $\angle BXY=\angle AXT=u$、$\angle BYX=\angle CYZ=v$、$\angle CZY=\angle DZT=w$、$\angle DTZ=\angle ATX=s$。
在三角形 $BXY,CYZ,DZT,ATX$ 中分别有 $u+v+b=\pi$、$v+w+c=\pi$、$w+s+d=\pi$、$s+u+a=\pi$。比较第一式与第三式之和及另外两式之和，必得 $b+d=a+c$。因此两边角和不等时不可能存在最短折线。

以下设 $a+c=b+d$。按顺序把四个面展开为 $ABC$、$BCD$、$CDA'$、$DA'B'$，相邻三角形放在公共边两侧，再在 $A'B'$ 外接一份 $ABC$ 的副本 $A'B'C'$。从 $AB$ 到 $A'B'$ 的有向转角之和为 $b-c+d-a=0$，所以 $\overrightarrow{A'B'}=\overrightarrow{AB}$。于是末尾的 $ABC$ 副本是开头副本沿向量 $v$ 的平移：$A'=A+v$、$B'=B+v$、$C'=C+v$。
令 $\omega=\angle ACB+\angle BCD+\angle DCA$。利用三角形内角和及 $a+c=b+d$，得到 $\alpha+\omega=2\pi$。又 $CA=CA'=AC$，由弦长公式 $|v|=AA'=2AC\sin(\omega/2)=2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$。
任一允许的折线展开后成为折线 $XYZTX'$，其中 $X'$ 是 $X$ 在 $A'B'$ 上的对应点，因此 $X'=X+v$。三角不等式给出 $XY+YZ+ZT+TX\ge XX'=|v|$。
下面说明该下界可以达到。使用平面观察：若射线 $OP,OQ,OR,OS$ 依次出现，三个相邻夹角 $p,q,r$ 均为锐角，且 $OP=OS$，把弦 $PS$ 放成水平后，$Q,R$ 都严格位于 $O$ 上方。事实上它们相对水平正方向的方向角为 $(\pi-p+q+r)/2$ 与 $(\pi-p-q+r)/2$，均在 $(0,\pi)$ 内。
在 $C$ 点把该观察用于 $CA,CB,CD,CA'$，在 $A'$ 点用于 $A'C,A'D,A'B',A'C'$。令 $v$ 水平，则集合 $\{A,C,A'\}$ 中各点严格低于 $\{B,D,B'\}$ 中各点。因此两者之间存在非空水平开带；其中每条水平线依次与 $AB,BC,CD,DA',A'B'$ 的内部相交于 $X,Y,Z,T,X'$，并组成直线段 $XX'$。
把各面折回即得到长度为 $|v|=2AC\sin(\alpha/2)$ 的闭折线。开带内有无穷多条水平线，因此得到无穷多条不同的最短折线。

imo-1971-q5.summary: For every natural number $m$, construct a finite set $S$ of points in the plane such that every point of $S$ has exactly $m$ other points of $S$ at distance $1$.
imo-1971-q5.summaryZh: 对每个自然数 $m$，构造平面上的有限点集 $S$，使 $S$ 中每个点恰有 $m$ 个其他点与它的距离为 $1$。
imo-1971-q5.answer: Such a finite set exists for every $m$; it can be built inductively by adjoining a carefully translated copy.
imo-1971-q5.answerZh: 对每个 $m$ 都存在这样的有限点集；可通过加入适当平移的副本归纳构造。

methods.title: Double the set with one controlled new neighbour
methods.titleZh: 复制点集并只增加一个受控邻点
steps: For $m=0$, one point suffices. Assume a finite nonempty set $S$ has exactly $m$ unit-distance neighbours at every point.

Let $D=\{p-q:p,q\in S,\ p
e q\}$. Choose a unit vector $u$ such that $u
e d$ and $|u-d|
e1$ for every $d\in D$. This is possible: each fixed $d$ excludes at most one point by $u=d$ and at most two more because $|u-d|=1$ cuts the unit circle by a line; only finitely many unit vectors are forbidden.
Set $T=S\cup(S+u)$. The two copies are disjoint because $u$ is not a nonzero difference of points of $S$.

Each point keeps its $m$ unit neighbours within its own copy. Across the two copies, $p$ is at unit distance from its corresponding point $p+u$. For distinct $p,q\in S$, the choice of $u$ gives $|p-(q+u)|=|u-(p-q)|\ne1$.
Thus every point of $T$ has exactly $m+1$ unit-distance neighbours. Induction proves the construction for every natural number $m$.
stepsZh: 当 $m=0$ 时，一个点即可。假设有限非空点集 $S$ 中每个点恰有 $m$ 个单位距离邻点。

令 $D=\{p-q:p,q\in S,\ p
e q\}$。选择单位向量 $u$，使对每个 $d\in D$ 都有 $u
e d$ 且 $|u-d|
e1$。这样的 $u$ 存在：固定一个 $d$ 时，条件 $u=d$ 至多排除单位圆上一点，而 $|u-d|=1$ 等价于一条直线与单位圆相交，至多再排除两点；所有禁用方向仍只有有限个。
令 $T=S\cup(S+u)$。因为 $u$ 不是 $S$ 中两点的非零差向量，两个副本互不相交。
每个点在自己的副本内仍有 $m$ 个单位距离邻点。两个副本之间，$p$ 与对应点 $p+u$ 的距离为 $1$。若 $p,q\in S$ 不同，则由 $u$ 的选择有 $|p-(q+u)|=|u-(p-q)|\ne1$。
因此 $T$ 中每个点恰有 $m+1$ 个单位距离邻点。由归纳法，对每个自然数 $m$ 均可构造。

imo-1971-q6.summary: Let $A=(a_{ij})$ be an $n\times n$ matrix of nonnegative integers. Whenever $a_{ij}=0$, assume that the sum of row $i$ and column $j$ is at least $n$. Prove that the sum of all entries of $A$ is at least $n^2/2$.
imo-1971-q6.summaryZh: 设 $A=(a_{ij})$ 是一个 $n\times n$ 非负整数矩阵。若 $a_{ij}=0$，则假设第 $i$ 行元素和与第 $j$ 列元素和之和至少为 $n$。证明矩阵全部元素之和至少为 $n^2/2$。

methods.title: Use the smallest row or column sum
steps: Let $S$ be the sum of all entries and let $m$ be the least among all row sums and column sums. If $m\ge n/2$, summing the $n$ row sums immediately gives $S\ge nm\ge n^2/2$.

Suppose $m<n/2$. After transposing if necessary, choose a row whose sum is $m$. Because nonzero entries are positive integers, this row contains at most $m$ nonzero entries and therefore at least $n-m$ zeros.

For each column containing one of these zeros, the hypothesis says its column sum is at least $n-m$. There are at least $n-m$ such columns. Every remaining column has sum at least $m$ by the definition of $m$.
Consequently $S\ge(n-m)^2+m^2=n^2/2+2(m-n/2)^2\ge n^2/2$, as required.
stepsZh: 设矩阵全部元素之和为 $S$，并令 $m$ 为所有行和、列和中的最小值。若 $m\ge n/2$，把 $n$ 个行和相加即得 $S\ge nm\ge n^2/2$。
以下设 $m<n/2$。必要时转置矩阵，可取某一行的行和等于 $m$。由于非零元素都是正整数，该行至多有 $m$ 个非零元素，因而至少有 $n-m$ 个零元素。
对含有这些零元素的每一列，题设给出其列和至少为 $n-m$；这样的列至少有 $n-m$ 列。其余每一列的列和由 $m$ 的定义至少为 $m$。
